inv.desc_es:
Madrid Real Estate presenta en exclusiva este magnífico local situado en el corazón del Barrio de Salamanca con Terraza retranqueada y salida de humos, una de las zonas más codiciadas de Madrid, con gran tránsito diario de oficinas y residentes.

Las fotografías son de referencia y la localización es aproximada. Por petición de nuestros clientes mantenemos máxima discreción.

Características del Local:

Superficie total: 235 m² aprox.

Aforo legal: 110 personas (16 en terraza retranqueada)

Licencia: Restaurante con salida de humos

Horario autorizado: 13:00h – 02:00h

Equipamiento: Entrega con todo el equipamiento actual

Terraza Retranqueada: Ideal para disfrutar del exterior, con capacidad para 16 personas

Ubicación: Excelente, con paso diario de trabajadores de oficinas, residentes y clientes de la zona

Datos Económicos:
- Traspaso: 250.000 € (NO Negociable)
- Alquiler mensual: 3.800 €
- Fianza y garantías: A convenir (orientativo 4+2)

Oportunidad de Negocio:
Este local es perfecto para:
- Restaurante gourmet o casual, Brunch, Bakery o Cafetería, Coworking-Restaurant, Franquicias gastronómicas, Proyectos innovadores tipo Estrella Michelin

Zona y Competencia:
Local estratégicamente ubicado junto a oficinas de Andersen (Abogados), AIS Consultores Financieros, BBVA, Percasi España y Utopicus. Operadores de referencia en la zona incluyen: Gracias Padre, Le Coq, Mamma Roma, La Tierruca, Marisquería El Cantábrico, El Buey, Taberna Verdejo, Txirimiri, Nap Goya, Mano de Santa, La Ancha, Manolo Bakes, Santerra y 100 Montaditos.

inv.desc_en:
Madrid Real Estate exclusively presents this magnificent commercial space located in the heart of the Salamanca neighborhood with a recessed terrace and smoke extraction, one of the most coveted areas of Madrid, with high daily foot traffic from offices and residents.

The photographs are for reference and the location is approximate. At our clients' request, we maintain maximum discretion.

Property Features:
Total area: approx. 235 m²
Legal capacity: 110 people (16 on the recessed terrace)
License: Restaurant with smoke extraction
Authorized hours: 1:00 PM – 2:00 AM
Equipment: Delivered with all current equipment
Recessed Terrace: Ideal for enjoying the outdoors, with capacity for 16 people
Location: Excellent, with daily foot traffic from office workers, residents, and local customers

Financial Data:
- Transfer fee (Traspaso): €250,000 (Non-negotiable)
- Monthly rent: €3,800
- Deposit and guarantees: To be agreed upon (indicative 4+2)

Business Opportunity:
This space is perfect for:
- Gourmet or casual restaurant, Brunch, Bakery or Coffee shop, Coworking-Restaurant, Gastronomic franchises, Innovative Michelin-star type projects

Area and Competition:
Strategically located next to the offices of Andersen (Lawyers), AIS Financial Consultants, BBVA, Percasi España, and Utopicus. Reference operators in the area include: Gracias Padre, Le Coq, Mamma Roma, La Tierruca, Marisquería El Cantábrico, El Buey, Taberna Verdejo, Txirimiri, Nap Goya, Mano de Santa, La Ancha, Manolo Bakes, Santerra, and 100 Montaditos.

Madrid Real Estate: Experts in hospitality business transfers in Prime areas of Madrid. We analyze every opportunity with rigor to ensure success. Sale of commercial premises with or without tenants for profitability. We are discreet, fast, and efficient.

Contact us for more information.

Important note: The information provided is indicative and does not constitute a binding offer. Subject to modifications according to the owner's instructions.

Let's be discreet...
